_comment: Sample proxy stanza for agent-config.json (PAT-278). The full agent-config is fetched and verified by patched-fetch-config.sh; this shows only the proxy sub-object.

proxy._comment_mode: system = honour the STATIC proxy in macOS System Settings via `scutil --proxy` (default); manual = use host/port below; off = force direct (no proxy). NOTE: PAC (proxy auto-config) files are NOT evaluated — a configured PAC is logged as a warning and the agent falls back to static settings or direct. PAC sites should pin a static proxy via manual mode.
proxy._comment_type: http or socks5. Prefer type "https" (TLS to the proxy) when using auth_ref, so the proxy credentials are not sent in cleartext; basic-auth over an "http" proxy is logged as a warning.
proxy._comment_auth: auth_ref is a macOS Keychain service name. The daemon reads username + password at runtime via `security find-generic-password` and passes them only via the proxy env vars (never argv/logs). Never put plaintext credentials in this file.
proxy._comment_no_proxy: Hosts that bypass the proxy. curl matches exact hostnames, domain suffixes ("corp.example.com" covers *.corp.example.com), and individual IPs — it does NOT honour CIDR ranges, so a CIDR entry silently never matches and is logged as a warning. Use a domain suffix instead.
proxy._comment_bypass: bypass_when_off_corp: the daemon always probes the proxy before use. When true and the proxy is unreachable (off-corp), it falls back to direct; when false it keeps using the proxy (egress fails closed) and logs a warning. Set probe_url to a URL reachable only on-corp; leave empty to TCP-probe host:port.
